t: Prompt and Pray - aka The 'Copy-on-First-Run' Pattern: Protecting User Work in an Auto-Updating App
s: This article details the 'Copy-on-First-Run' pattern to resolve the conflict between auto-updating applications and user-editable stateful files like Jupyter Notebooks, ensuring user work is preserved without breaking the update mechanism.
sub: Conflict: Auto-Update vs. User-Editable Stateful Notebooks
AI-Assisted Architectural Flaw Identification and Solution
